verdict.rationale: First-party docs show an 8-GPU DGX B300 system with 2.3 TB of GPU memory and 8 x 800 Gb/s InfiniBand/Ethernet cluster networking over ConnectX-8. They also cover MGX and enterprise rack compatibility, DGX SuperPOD scaling for training and inference, and NIM multi-node deployment on Kubernetes. That covers multi-GPU systems and scale-out, but the GPU-to-GPU NVLink fabric and the rack-scale topology are not documented in the pack. missing for 10: documented NVLink/NVSwitch GPU-to-GPU bandwidth, concrete rack-scale (e.g., NVL72/SuperPOD) topology specs, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-node training/serving.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can train and serve at datacenter scale on this part — documented high-bandwidth interconnect (NVLink, Infinity Fabric), multi-GPU systems, and rack-scale deployment
